tabs.title: Description
tabs.html:
Silicom PE310G4SPI9L-XR-CX3 Quad-Port 10GbE PCI Express SFP+ Network Adapter

The Silicom PE310G4SPI9L-XR-CX3 is a high-performance quad-port 10 Gigabit Ethernet network adapter designed for enterprise servers, virtualization platforms, and high-bandwidth networking environments. Featuring the powerful Intel® 82599ES controller and a PCI Express Gen3 x8 interface, this adapter ensures low latency, high throughput, and efficient data processing with minimal CPU load.

Key Features:

  • Quad-Port 10Gb Ethernet via SFP+ interfaces
  • Intel® 82599ES controller for reliable and high-performance networking
  • PCI Express Gen3 x8 interface for maximum data transfer speed
  • Low-profile design suitable for compact server installations
  • Supports 10GBASE-SR, 10GBASE-LR, and other SFP+ modules
  • Compatible with Windows and Linux operating systems
  • Ideal for data centers, high-performance computing, storage networking, and virtualized environments

Specifications:

  • Ports: 4 x SFP+
  • Interface: PCIe Gen3 x8
  • Form Factor: Low Profile
  • Power Consumption: Approximately 16.44W
  • Dimensions: 167.64mm x 85.77mm
  • Operating Temperature: 0°C to 45°C
  • Humidity: 0% to 90%, non-condensing
